sql: select v.version, r.verdict, left(r.metrics_json::text,700) as metrics, r.computed_at::text as computed from experiment_versions v join experiment_gates g on g.version_id=v.id join experiment_gate_results r on r.gate_id=g.id where v.experiment_id=(select id from experiments where key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity') and g.gate_key='paper_to_live_canary' and v.version=3 order by r.id desc limit 2
